verdict.rationale: The axis applies because GST runs a Developer Portal with API registration and login, so a machine channel exists and a sandbox is a fair question. However, nothing in the evidence documents a public sandbox or test environment for exercising that channel end to end. The rest of the pack covers taxpayer-facing help modules (registration, returns, the offline upload tool, payments) and an unrelated income-tax portal probe, none of which address a test environment.
